The '''mace''' is crafted from a heavy core, a stick and an iron ingot instead of a breeze rod.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
It has {{Value|Mace|durability}} durability and is repaired with iron ingots; its tooltip shows 6 damage and 0.6 attack speed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/mace.json}}</ref>

Besides the vanilla mace enchantments, it can take the pack's [[Anemos]], from the [[Prayer of Aeolus]]. {{MCW|Wind Burst}} comes from the [[Elegy of Hyacinthus]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/item/enchantable/anemos.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/hyacinthus.json}}</ref>
